d:
Around 2,500 years ago, in King Janaka's court, a remarkable philosophical debate took place between Gargi Vachaknavi and the great sage Yajnavalkya.
It began with 1,000 cows whose horns were decorated with gold, but soon turned into a profound discussion about the nature of existence, the universe, space, and the ultimate reality. When Gargi asked what the entire universe rests upon, Yajnavalkya warned her to stop asking questions or risk having her head split open. But Gargi was not finished. She stood up again and challenged him with an even deeper question.
